slides.main: A FODMAP list is a swap list, not a list of banned foods.
slides.sub: Why portions matter, what to swap, and who it is for.

slides.main: Fermentable carbs that are not fully absorbed and get fermented into gas.
slides.sub: Most people eat them every day without trouble. In IBS, the gut can be more sensitive.

slides.main: The same food can be low or high FODMAP depending on the serving.
slides.sub: You cannot guess FODMAP content. It has to be measured in a lab.

slides.main: Swap wheat toast with honey for sourdough spelt toast with jam.
slides.sub: Or your daily apple for an orange. Before cutting out wheat, get tested for coeliac disease.

slides.main: Swap for 2 to 6 weeks, then reintroduce one group at a time.
slides.sub: In the end you only limit what triggers symptoms. A dietitian with IBS experience should guide you.

slides.main: Low FODMAP is for diagnosed IBS. See a doctor first, especially with:
items: Blood in your stool or black stools
Symptoms that first started after age 50
Coeliac disease or IBD in your family
